question: Does 2026 firsthand evidence establish Midnight Milling nominal input batch and same-herb/rank selector behavior, and can an unmatched 10-pigment report validate or falsify the legacy 3-6 preview bounds?
taskSelection: Zero-delta pivot away from repeatedly unresolvable Dragonflight rank-specific diamond and TWW milling skill-rate searches to a distinct current-expansion reagent-denominator and selector question.

sources.author: Errtu
caveats: Reported inability to combine different herb kinds/quality ranks, not an exhaustive recipe selector matrix
No cast log, build, skill, output totals or refunds

candidateAudit.interpretation: Candidate already encodes 10-herb nominal batch; no five-to-ten patch is warranted. The unmatched 10-pigment report conflicts with the legacy display bound only if recipe, rank, skill and units match; none are established.

applicability.relatedPendingQueue30: Midnight alternate pigment-rank eligibility leads remain unresolved
applicability.specificQuestionResolved: 10 herbs nominally per Midnight Milling operation, not 5, with firsthand report of same herb/rank selection constraints
notResolved: Which exact output rank appears for each input rank and skill
Whether rank mixing can ever be permitted by an alternate operation
Any 2026 zero-inclusive E, P or conditional yield distribution
Whether the David111 anecdote refers to the same recipe/profile as legacy 3-6
applicability.notApplicableTo: Classic 5-herb milling or separate housing dye-pigment recipes

controlledMeasurement.question: At fixed Midnight herb input ID and rank, do ten units produce output quantity >6, and can any mixed herb/rank inputs be selected for a single operation?
capture: Client build, UTC, recipe spellID and full reagent vector with quality ranks
Exact herb and pigment IDs, quality ranks, profession skill/spec/equipment and buffs
Actual completed casts including zero output, output histogram and cooutputs
Gross consumed herbs, separate Resourcefulness refunds and aborted casts
Selector attempts for mixed rank and herb types recorded as accepted/rejected, not fabricated zero outputs
controlledMeasurement.holdout: Repeat matched skill/rank context in independent session/character before economic promotion

blockers: No actual cast-level output histogram or matched context for 10-pigment anecdote
Cannot prove current patch behavior beyond source observation epoch
Pending alternate output rank selector universe requires client verification
